summary: Iteration 43 — tested Phase 1 pre-launch punch-list (transfer type, merchant, splits, activity filters, WEALTH BY CATEGORY) at 390x844 mobile viewport with alex+test1@jaleter.app. Result: 5/6 features PASS via UI Playwright; 1 feature (WEALTH BY CATEGORY card) is COMPLETELY BROKEN by a Temporal-Dead-Zone (TDZ) crash — the entire NetWorthScreen fails to render with a red-screen 'Uncaught Error — Cannot access manualCash before initialization' at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:2999 (called from line 3021 buildCategoryGroups, but manualCash is declared later at line 3061). PASSED via UI: (a) TxForm now shows Income/Expense/Transfer pills — tx-type-Income/Expense/Transfer all render; selecting Transfer hides category picker (tx-group-steward absent) and shows the informational tan-tinted card with copy 'This transaction is an internal movement between your own accounts (or a credit-card payment). It won't affect income, expense, or Net Worth totals.' (b) Merchant field renders between Description and Amount with testID tx-merchant, has placeholder 'e.g., Costco, Chevron, Whole Foods', and helper text 'Merchant is used in Reports to group your spending by retailer.' (c) '+ Split this' button (tx-split-toggle) expands the Splits section with 2 initial rows; 'Add split' (tx-split-add) adds another; per-row testIDs tx-split-{idx}-amount / tx-split-{idx}-group-* / tx-split-{idx}-sub-* / tx-split-{idx}-remove all wired. Save button correctly disabled (aria-disabled=true) when splits are under-allocated (40+30 → '$30 left'), over-allocated (60+60 → '$20 over'), or contain any zero-amount row; save enabled ONLY when sum=total AND every row > 0. (d) Activity filter pills 'All / Income / Expenses / Transfers' all render (testIDs tx-filter-All, tx-filter-Income, tx-filter-Expenses, tx-filter-Transfers). Transfers pill filter narrows list correctly (verified by later Expenses filter that hid the transfer). (e) Activity transaction rows show ' · Merchant' when merchant differs from description (verified in-form) and ' · Transfer' badge for type=transfer. Split (N) badge code path present at index.tsx L2523 (not verified via full save→list roundtrip because the split-save test hit the always-positive-per-row validation with a 3rd empty row). FAILED via UI: WEALTH BY CATEGORY card renders NOWHERE — the entire Wealth (Net Worth) tab throws a red screen the moment it mounts. Backend Plaid mapper (merchant + credit_card_payment classification) accepted as pre-verified per review request note. One additional UX inconsistency: when splits total the transaction amount but a row still has $0, the summary chip shows 'Balanced' (green) while the Save button is disabled and the error text says 'Splits must total exactly $X and have at least 2 rows' — the chip is misleading in this state.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL RED SCREEN — Uncaught ReferenceError: Cannot access 'manualCash' before initialization. buildCategoryGroups() at index.tsx:2991 references manualCash and manualInvest, and is called immediately at lines 3021-3022 (const assetGroups = buildCategoryGroups('assets')). But manualCash/manualInvest are only declared at lines 3061-3062. This TDZ crash means the entire Wealth tab (Assets card, Liabilities card, WEALTH BY CATEGORY card, Set Aside sheet) never renders for any user — not just users with linked accounts. Fix: move the two `const manualCash = ...` / `const manualInvest = ...` declarations from lines 3061-3062 to BEFORE line 2991 (before buildCategoryGroups is defined and used). Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:2999,3021,3061.

When splits sum EXACTLY equals the transaction total but any row's amount is still 0 (e.g., $50 + $50 + $0 on 3 rows totaling $100), the green 'Balanced' chip appears while Save remains disabled with the tan-error text 'Splits must total exactly $100 and have at least 2 rows'. The chip label should degrade to something like 'Fix empty rows' when splitsValid is false despite splitsRemaining being 0. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:2821-2823 (chip label uses `Math.abs(splitsRemaining) < 0.01`) vs 2557 (splitsValid also requires `.every((sp) => Number(sp.amount) > 0)`).

critical_code_review_comments: TDZ CRASH — /app/frontend/app/index.tsx L2991-3022: `buildCategoryGroups` closure captures `manualCash` and `manualInvest`, which are `const`-declared at lines 3061-3062. Both closures are then executed synchronously at L3021-3022 (buildCategoryGroups('assets') and ('liabilities')). Since manualCash/manualInvest are in the TDZ at execution time, JS throws before any JSX renders. Fix: hoist the two consts above L2991.

Split validation (L2554-2557) correctly checks (a) 2+ rows, (b) |remaining| < 0.01, and (c) every row > 0 — matches spec. Save button disabled correctly (L2847). Error copy at L2851-2853 fires appropriately.
Merchant field wired correctly — value bound to tx.merchant at L2623, testID=tx-merchant, helper text L2629-2631. Save handler trims and drops empty string to undefined at L2834+2841.

Transfer type transition (L2604-2615) — clears groupId to '' (empty), detailId to undefined, splits to [] and setShowSplits(false). isTransfer flag correctly hides category picker (L2710 `!isTransfer && !showSplits`) and the split section (L2753 `!isTransfer`). Info card at L2698-2706 renders with correct copy.
Activity filter (L2393-2401) — Transfers = tx.type==='transfer' OR isSystemTransaction(t); Income/Expenses filters explicitly exclude transfers via `if (isTransfer) return false`. Correct per spec.
Activity row rendering (L2505-2529) — badge composition ` · Transfer` and ` · Split (N)` correct; merchant appended only when it differs from name.
Wealth deduplication (L2956-2970) — dedupes by (link_id, account_id) using Set keys, filters zero-balance rows matching insurance regex. Both correct per spec.

buildCategoryGroups + assetGroups/liabilityGroups (L2991-3024) — logic correct: rowCount hides zero-total empty categories at L3534, manualSeedValue folds Manual Cash/Investments into the Cash/Investments totals, category totals equal sum of linkedRows + manualSeed + manualExtras (no double-counting). Once the TDZ bug is fixed this should render correctly.

Backend Plaid mapper (plaid_service.py:173-229) — sets `merchant` from Plaid's canonicalized merchant_name (falls back to None, not to description), and `system_category` via `classify_system` which returns 'credit_card_payment' for Plaid PFC 'LOAN_PAYMENTS_CREDIT_CARD_PAYMENT'. Both fields correctly persisted on the bank_transactions doc and surfaced via /api/accounts/transactions.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the WEALTH BY CATEGORY red screen: JavaScript Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ) violation. In /app/frontend/app/index.tsx the NetWorthScreen component (starting L2906) defines `buildCategoryGroups` at L2991 which closes over `manualCash` and `manualInvest` (used at L2999). It then immediately invokes buildCategoryGroups at L3021-3022. However, `const manualCash` and `const manualInvest` are only declared at L3061-3062 — AFTER the invocation. Because `const` bindings live in the TDZ until their declaration line is reached, the L3021 invocation throws `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'manualCash' before initialization`, which bubbles up and Expo Router renders the Uncaught-Error red screen. Reproduction: log in as any user → tap nav-networth. Fix: move the two `const` declarations (currently L3061-3062) to before L2991 — anywhere earlier in the function body is safe since they only depend on `assets`, which is a prop. After the move, retest by mounting the Wealth screen for a user with zero, some, and many linked accounts.
